issue.title: Fix Waveform Scrubbing to Seek to Tapped Position
issue.body:
QA on #409 found that when a user records multiple verses in Pericope Mode, the recording plays back as a single combined audio unit. Tapping a point on the draft waveform to scrub does not seek playback to that position; instead, playback restarts from the beginning of the recording. Tapping the waveform should move playback to the tapped position.

## Functional Requirements

### Waveform Scrubbing
- Tapping a point on the draft waveform in Pericope or Verse Mode should seek playback to that position in the recording.
- Do not restart playback from the beginning when the waveform is tapped.

comments.body:
**Finding from the #528 audit (Play, record, and re-record audio)**

Device: Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10, running merged `main` against `dev.api.fluent.bible`.

In verse mode, tapping the middle of a draft take's waveform now **seeks to the tapped position**, but:

- playback **starts on its own** after the tap, and
- the take control keeps showing **Play** instead of Pause.

In `useVerseAudio.seek`, `playingTakeId` is set but no `PLAY` is dispatched, so the card's `isThisPlaying` (which requires `state === 'playing'`) stays false.

The same tap also raises `Maximum update depth exceeded` (dev LogBox). That is tracked separately in #569.

Suggested additional AC for this issue:

- [ ] After a waveform tap, the take control reflects the real playback state (Pause while playing), and playback does not auto-start unless it was already playing.

Assessment: `docs/assessments/play-record-rerecord-audio/` (PR #566).

**Test Results: 544-Mobile**

- Verified that tapping a point on the draft waveform seeks playback to the corresponding position in the recording in Pericope Mode.
- Verified that waveform scrubbing also works correctly in Verse Mode.
- Confirmed that tapping the waveform moves playback to the selected position instead of restarting the recording from the beginning.
- Verified that waveform scrubbing works as expected when recording multiple verses in Pericope Mode.
